IDBI Bank Latest News 2026: Why are bank unions protesting against the IDBI Bank stake sale to Fairfax Financial Holdings? Understand the ₹52,878 crore deal, bank privatization, employee concerns, and its possible impact on India's banking sector.
On October 14, 2026, the Union Cabinet approved the sale of a 60.72% stake in IDBI Bank to a Fairfax-backed entity for approximately ₹52,878 crore. The proposed transaction includes a 30.48% stake held by the Government of India and a 30.24% stake held by LIC.

• IDBI Bank stake sale latest news
• Why the government approved the Fairfax deal
• Why bank unions are opposing IDBI Bank privatization
• What the ₹52,878 crore deal means
• Government and LIC shareholding after the proposed sale
• Employee job security, pension and service condition concerns
• Possible impact on bank customers and shareholders
• IDBI Bank privatization and India's banking sector
• What happens next in the stake sale process

The bank unions have raised concerns about valuation, employee interests, foreign ownership and the future role of IDBI Bank. The government has stated that existing employee service conditions will remain protected.

Watch the complete video for a clear explanation of the IDBI Bank sale, Fairfax Financial Holdings, bank union protests and the future of the bank.
